tools.name: get_agent_setup_prompt
tools.description: Read the setup guide for an AI coding agent that puts a developer's local app online with the ngrok agent and verifies the endpoint.

tools.name: get_agent_skill
tools.description: Read one of ngrok's agent skills (a SKILL.md) by name. The index at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json lists the names and descriptions.

name.description: The skill name from the index, such as expose-localhost.

tools.name: get_auth_instructions
tools.description: Read how an agent gets and uses ngrok credentials: API keys for api.ngrok.com, authtokens for the ngrok agent, and AI Gateway keys.

tools.name: get_blog_index
tools.description: Read the blog's llms.txt: what the ngrok blog covers and where its feeds and indexes are.

tools.name: get_changelog_feed
tools.description: Read the ngrok changelog as an RSS feed: each entry's title, summary, date, products, and URL, newest first.

tools.name: get_docs_page
tools.description: Read one page of the ngrok documentation as markdown. Pass the path after /docs/ with no extension, for example gateway/traffic-policy, api, or agent/cli. The page index is at /docs/llms.txt.

path.description: The docs path after /docs/, such as gateway/traffic-policy.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Read ngrok's plans, limits, and prices as markdown, with dollar amounts served live from billing.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Read ngrok's llms.txt: what ngrok is, its products, and links to the docs, the API, and its agent-facing documents.

tools.name: open_blog_post
tools.description: Open one blog post in this tab by its slug. search_blog_posts returns the slugs.

slug.description: The post slug, such as probes.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a page on ngrok.com in this tab. Use the get_* tools instead when you only need a document's content.

path.description: /: Home; /pricing: Pricing; /download: Download the ngrok agent; /gateway: Universal Gateway; /use-cases/share-localhost: Share localhost; /use-cases/api-gateway: API gateway; /use-cases/ai-agent-connectivity: AI agent connectivity; /customers: Customers; /contact: Contact sales; /support: Support; /docs: Documentation

tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Search the ngrok blog by words in a post's title, description, author, or tags. Omit the query for the newest posts. Returns each post's slug, title, description, date, author, tags, and URL.

query.description: Words to match. Every word must appear somewhere in the post's metadata.
